types.hours: Hours — points per N hours declared
types.capped: Capped — either type, with a maximum
types.cappedPerDocument: Capped per document — either type, with a per-document maximum

rule.maxTotalPointsHint: Applies to the sum across all documents combined.
rule.maxPerDocumentHint: Each document is capped individually — logging more documents still adds up.

flat.pointsPerUnitNotFinite: Points per document must be a finite number.
flat.pointsPerUnitNotPositive: Points per document must be greater than zero.

hours.pointsPerUnitNotFinite: Points awarded must be a finite number.
hours.pointsPerUnitNotPositive: Points awarded must be greater than zero.
hours.unitSizeNotFinite: Hours per unit must be a finite number.
hours.unitSizeNotPositive: Hours per unit must be greater than zero.

capped.missingInner: A capped rule must reference a valid inner rule.
capped.invalidInnerType: The inner rule must be of type "flat" or "hours".
capped.capNotFinite: The maximum must be a finite number.
capped.capNotPositive: The maximum must be greater than zero.

cappedPerDocument.missingInner: A capped-per-document rule must reference a valid inner rule.
cappedPerDocument.invalidInnerType: The inner rule must be of type "flat" or "hours".
cappedPerDocument.capPerDocumentNotFinite: The maximum per document must be a finite number.
cappedPerDocument.capPerDocumentNotPositive: The maximum per document must be greater than zero.
